thesis: Changing effective regimes, varying parameters and changing fundamental rules are distinct claims.
role: Clarify measurable change and speculative metalaws.

ideas.statement: Dimensionless ratios distinguish physical change from unit conventions; common changes in every internal standard cannot be detected against an external time by assumption.
Changing laws require a mechanism or metalaw; observer selection and cosmological reproduction proposals remain conditional explanations, not proof of simulation.
Measurement error, a narrower domain and different dynamics are distinct reasons for revision; anomalies do not automatically reveal an author.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The Smolin–Vilenkin dispute is theoretical controversy rather than observed universe reproduction; an endless hierarchy is metaphysical possibility.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
